entries.title: Run checks on the pinned Node 22.20.0 / npm 11.16.0 from ~/.local/node-22.20.0
entries.text: The host has Node 24 / npm 12; packages pin node >=22.19 <23 and npm >=11.16 <12 with engine-strict. Maintainer decided 2026-11-13 to stay on Node 22 (production images node:22.23.2, CI .nvmrc 22.20.0); a Node 24 upgrade is a separate later task. Official node-v22.20.0-linux-x64 (SHA256 verified against nodejs.org SHASUMS256.txt) is unpacked at $HOME/.local/node-22.20.0 with npm 11.16.0. Prefix every npm/node command: PATH="$HOME/.local/node-22.20.0/bin:$PATH" npm ci && PATH="$HOME/.local/node-22.20.0/bin:$PATH" npm run check. Never use --engine-strict=false or edit engines/.nvmrc.

entries.title: Run all checks in the Node 22 container: tools/node22-container/run.sh <command>
entries.text: Maintainer does not want a second Node on the host (2026-11-13). tools/node22-container builds a local image boe-node22-check:22.20.0-alpine3.22 (official node:22.20.0-alpine3.22 + git 2.49 + bash + npm 11.16.0; Alpine like the production images, git new enough for relativeWorktrees). From any checkout or tally worktree subfolder run: <repo>/tools/node22-container/run.sh sh -c 'npm ci && npm run check'. It runs as your uid, mounts the worktree and git common dir at their real paths, keeps the npm cache in <worktree>/.temp/npm-cache, and passes /var/run/docker.sock with DOCKER_HOST and TESTCONTAINERS_HOST_OVERRIDE=localhost on host network so npm run test:integration works (baseline 35 files/390 tests passed). node_modules installed in the container are Alpine builds; do not mix with host npm.

entries.title: Landing E3 (Node 24): switch tally commands.test to the Node 24 container in the same landing
entries.text: When lane e-node24 lands (only when DEC-57 allows: after Phase I is released, as its own release), every package's .npmrc has engine-strict=true and engines becomes >=24.11.0 <25, so the Node 22 check container refuses npm ci, and the Node 24 container refuses main before E3. In one step with nothing else landing in between: rebase e-node24 onto main, re-run the full sweep in tools/node24-container, change docs/records/config.json commands.test from tools/node22-container/run.sh to tools/node24-container/run.sh with repo_configure, then land. In the same landing docs commit update howto-2, the plan's E3 entry and CLAUDE.md, record the Node 22 container's removal condition in the plan, and correct the handoff wording (MaskedEmail has no consumer). Source: review-8.
